workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Sandboxed datetime hints can fail decoding and drop signals
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix sandboxed datetime decoding with replay compatibility. Target files: temporalio/_workflow_context.py, temporalio/converter/_payload_converter.py, temporalio/worker/_replayer.py. This PR exposes the current workflow's runtime flags as a context variable. That is then used in the default payload converter to detect if it should unwrap a sandboxed `datetime` type hint to be backward compatible with existing histories. New activations set a new datetime conversion flag on start to ensure that the first WFT processed en... (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python/pull/2094)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] `with_passthrough_all_modules()` fails for a workflow defined in `__main__`: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named '__temporal_main__'`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix passthrough_all_modules for a workflow defined in __main__. Target files: temporalio/worker/workflow_sandbox/_importer.py, tests/worker/workflow_sandbox/test_importer.py, tests/worker/workflow_sandbox/test_runner.py. A script that defines its workflow in __main__ can now start a worker with the sandbox set to pass all modules through. Before, creating the worker failed with "Failed validating workflow InMain", caused by "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named '__temporal_main__'". Passing __temporal_main__ through by... (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python/pull/2141)

workarounds.symptom: Eviction retries forever when a deadlock interrupt lands while a finished task schedules its done callbacks
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix stuck workflow eviction after deadlocks. Target files: temporalio/worker/_workflow.py, temporalio/worker/_workflow_instance.py, tests/worker/test_workflow_deadlock.py. During cancellation, `asyncio.wait_for` marks the `asyncio.Future` as cancelled even if the underlying `concurrent.futures.Future` declines cancellation b/c it's running or finished. If cancellation is declined, eviction could start too early and retry indefinitiely. (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python/pull/2142)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] TaskGroup cancellation of mixed Temporal operations can break replay
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Warn against asyncio TaskGroup in workflows. Target files: temporalio/worker/workflow_sandbox/_restrictions.py, tests/worker/workflow_sandbox/test_runner.py, README.md. Warn when a sandboxed workflow constructs `asyncio.TaskGroup`, whose set-based cancellation order can produce nondeterministic Temporal commands during replay. (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python/pull/2085)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Sandbox blocks os.path during traceback formatting on Python 3.13.12+ (3.14 exemption misses the 3.13 backport)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Allow os.path in the workflow sandbox on Python 3.13.12+. Target files: temporalio/worker/workflow_sandbox/_restrictions.py, tests/worker/workflow_sandbox/test_restrictions.py, tests/worker/workflow_sandbox/test_runner.py. The `os` entry of the sandbox's default restrictions exempts `os.path` for `sys.version_info >= (3, 14)`. That check now reads `>= (3, 13, 12)`, in both places it is used (the `children` entry and the `exclude` set). The integration test that expects `os.path.abspath` to be rejected is limited to Pyt... (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python/pull/2061)
